unit_name: 17th SS Panzergrenadier Division Götz von Berlichingen
current_activity: moving up to block US westward thrust near Carentan
notes: Ordered 7 June to move against airborne threat; forward elements reached assembly areas southwest of Carentan by 11 June; made contact with US paratroopers 10 June; Ostendorff's division assigned the primary mission of blocking westward thrust under II Parachute Corps.

unit_name: 17th SS Panzergrenadier Division Götz von Berlichingen
composing_units: SS-Panzergrenadier Regiment 37; SS-Panzergrenadier Regiment 38; attached battle group from the 275th Division: Kampfgruppe Heintz (GER-KG-HEINTZ) after its arrival (CMH ch. IX)
engaged_with: US 101st Airborne Division; US 2nd Armored Division
notes: Counter-attacked 101st Airborne at dawn 13 June with armour (Bloody Gulch); repulsed with 2nd Armored Division CCA help. [v5: battle group added to composing_units.]
